column1: # Forever encrypted rows: the profession items of spec jvbastel/WOWAI#225 that the Forever client holds in encrypted
# data (US42). forever/generator leaves them out: it refuses an item row whose Forever data comes from one of them,
# and writes this list into encrypted-list.tsv, so that the post-launch refresh knows what to try again. They are
# not filled from fan sites. Never edit a generated file by hand. To gather the data again, see forever/REFRESH.md.
# Source: WoW Forever build 1.60.1.70685, recorded 2026-10-30: the dump items.tsv of #224, rows with the status
# "not readable in Forever ItemSparse/Item" (their ItemSparse rows sit in sections with an unknown TACT key, for
# example DA0E7785727A0A65). The names are those of the stock 1.12 item where the ID is stock, else of the Forever
# Item table. Only numbers and names.
# 148 rows by use: 63 made by Season of Discovery recipes (2 of them also reagents), 31 Season of Discovery plans, 22
# stock plans, 15 plans of new Forever recipes (blacksmithing.tsv has no row for them), 6 metal and stone, 5 Season of
# Discovery reagents, 4 stock crafted items (items.tsv: Rune Edge, Ironvine Breastplate, Gloves, Belt), 2 other
# recipe items. A name of - : the client cannot read the name either.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   foreverItem   the item ID in the Forever client (a stock ID or a new Forever ID)
#   name          the item name
#   used          where the profession data uses it (from the dump): creates:<group> (made by a recipe), plans:<group>
#                 (teaches a recipe), reagent:<group>, metal&stone, bs-recipe-item. Groups: stock, fv-new (new in
#                 Forever), sod (Season of Discovery)
#   notes         free text, or -
foreverItem
